title: Debug tools only in debug builds
description:
Make tool windows disappear from release builds without scattering `#ifdef`s.

```
debug build:   menu "Dev" with Console, Inspector, Profiler
release build: no Dev menu, and the tool code is not even compiled in
```
hints: `if constexpr` throws away the branch at compile time, but the code must still be valid in both builds (lesson 6.03).
A command-line switch (`--dev`) can turn the tools on in a test build too.
requirements: One `constexpr bool devTools` set from `NDEBUG` (or your own `XN_DEV_TOOLS` define).
Register tool windows in a table, and show the menu only `if constexpr (devTools)`.
stretch: Add a hidden key combination that opens the tools in a release build for testers.
